title: CrispPvP
description: CrispPvP is a lightweight resource pack crafted for PvP with short tools, low fire, and optimized visuals. Every texture is carefully designed to keep your focus sharp in battle.
body:
### ⚔️ CrispPvP Resource Pack
### 🎯 The Ultimate PvP Experience for Minecraft

> CrispPvP is a **high-performance resource pack** built from the ground up for competitive Minecraft PvP players. Every texture has been carefully crafted to give you the **sharpest, cleanest, and most optimized** visual experience possible. Stop losing fights because of bad textures — **start winning with CrispPvP!** 🏆

---

## ✨ Features

🚫🔥 **No Fire**
Fire overlay is completely **removed from your screen**. Stay in full control and never lose visibility when burning!

⚔️ **Mini Items**
All swords, tools and weapons are **compact and minimal** for maximum visibility. Keep your crosshair clean and your focus locked on the enemy at all times!

🎨 **Clean Textures**
Ultra-clean and simplified textures designed to **reduce visual noise**. Less distraction, more winning.

🔤 **Custom Font**
A unique custom font that makes your **chat, hotbar, and UI** look cleaner and more stylish than ever before.

---

## 🏆 Why Choose CrispPvP?

| ✅ Feature | 💬 Benefit |
|---|---|
| Short Swords | Better visibility in 1v1 fights |
| Low Fire | No more screen obstruction |
| Small Tools | Cleaner crosshair at all times |
| Clean Textures | Maximum FPS & focus |
| Lightweight | No lag, smooth performance |

---

## 🎮 Perfect For

- 🏹 **Sword PvP**
- 🧱 **UHC & SMP PvP**
- 🏰 **Faction Servers**
- 🎯 **Ranked Competitive Play**

---

## 📊 Pack Info

- ⚡ **Performance:** Lightweight & optimized
- 🎮 **Version:** 1.20 — 1.21
- 🔄 **Updates:** Regular updates & improvements

---

*Made with ❤️ for the PvP community — CrispPvP* ⚔️🔥
